sister of Gertrude Walter and Frances (Walter) Yonge

Daughter of Lt- Col Edward Walter, she married (1866) Francis Edward Halliday (1834-1911).

She was sister of Gertrude Walter, Frances Yonge and Mary (Walter) Woollcombe.

She had a large family of whom CMY most often mentions her daughter Georgina Frances (Halliday) Mansfield (b.1868/9) who was three in 1871. [India Office, Bombay Baptisms, 1871 census when they were staying at Medstead with cousins]
